scope: One Windows-applied UCRT dispatch-thunk transformation; not permission for arbitrary ntdll targets, other CFG/retpoline variants or additional unwind frames

references.session_limit: The read session receipt identifies the executable/artifact but has no retained failing CRT code window. The reported game srw_crt_code rejection is not attributed to this own-process transformation by this artifact.

operations_performed.qualification_limit: System-library bytes/metadata were read in isolated own helper processes, not the game. No claim that their ASLR addresses, active mitigation selection or transformed bytes are identical in the game.

ucrt.flag_limit: The SDK defines IMAGE_GUARD_RETPOLINE_PRESENT, but it is CLEAR in this actual CRT (and ntdll). The qualified transformation is the newer symbol7 function-override/SCP-NP path, not a flag-authorized generic retpoline exception. Do not require or pretend this bit is set.

ucrt_declared_fixup.meaning: The file explicitly declares the four-byte relative operand at f8011 as an override relocation associated with original function ed6a0. The E9 opcode at f8010 is not waived. This is not an ordinary DIR64 base relocation and not justified by ignoring all .text differences.
ucrt_declared_fixup.bdd_limit: BDD feature selection was not evaluated as a universal loader policy. The narrow acceptance recipe instead authenticates the particular final SCP-NP mapping/template/export relationships observed here. No claim that all hosts or mitigations select it.

callback_and_guard_relationship.own_sample_limit: The sample displacement is ASLR-dependent evidence, never a supported signature to copy into code.
callback_and_guard_relationship.guard_relationship: In the own sample fdba8 remains UCRT.base+ed6c0 after legitimate DIR64 rebasing; ed6a0 and ed6c0 bytes are unchanged. The rewritten direct stub bypasses ed6a0/fdba8. Thus verifying only the guard slot does not explain or authenticate the f8010 code change.
callback_and_guard_relationship.exe_import_relationship: The first-SRW profile's API-set _initterm import/IAT/thunk must still resolve to the actual authenticated UCRT export. No game IAT was read here; no permission to alter that import or accept an arbitrary export trampoline.
callback_and_guard_relationship.stack_and_register_effect: For this variant the actual path is CALL f8010, E9 rel32 to authenticated SCP-NP clone+c0, then bytes 48 ff e0 (JMP RAX). These two tail instructions neither push/pop nor change RAX or RSP; the callback remains the qword loaded by _initterm from RBX. They do not invoke a hidden callback, wait, or create another return frame. The existing exact callback return 707d6, cursor/end registers and EXE continuation requirements remain unchanged.

source_export_table.name: RtlpScpCfgNtdllExports
source_export_table.limit: These raw offsets are qualified for the pinned ntdll file, not an SDK-declared stable structure ABI.

own_clone_observation.limit: These relative addresses and device-volume spelling describe the own sample, not constants to accept in another process. A normal module SizeOfImage containment check will exclude this appended OS mapping; do not solve that by accepting all out-of-image pointers.

os_publication_witness.meaning: An OS-populated pointer in an independently authenticated exported ntdll initialization block corroborates this exact dispatch target. Read/recheck it; do not invoke it or treat a mutable pointer alone as proof. Raw offset is qualified only for this pinned ntdll.

ntdll_scp_np_provenance.unwind_limit: The appended mapping has no ordinary file RVA within ntdll SizeOfImage. Do not invent a .pdata entry for the clone. Its first executed instruction is the verified tail JMP RAX, so while the real callback is active there is no extra clone frame to skip. File source zero-operation unwind metadata corroborates the template; this research did not invoke RtlLookupFunctionEntry or qualify OS-generated exception tables for a PC stopped inside the clone.

minimum_bounded_read_recipe: Preserve every first-SRW/UAL source, primary-thread, exact EXE/unwind/register/cold-state and synchronous-hook-publication predicate. This is a narrowly qualified alternative for the CRT dispatch code check only, not a different startup source or a later-origin retry.

Authenticate the current mapped UCRT and ntdll against the two exact backing System32 files, full file hashes, PE identity, named exports and relevant loaded headers/export/exception/code metadata. Do not identify a module by basename, range alone or GetProcAddress equality. Different file hashes need independent review.

Require the entire loaded _initterm body, its CALL f8010/return 707d6 and primary unwind record to equal the pinned file. Require the EXE's existing _initterm import relationship. The only new allowed code difference in the selected stub is its four-byte operand at the metadata-declared f8011; keep opcode E9 and all remaining bytes of the 16-byte window exact.

Parse the bounded load-config/DVRT records from the pinned and corresponding loaded metadata. Require the exact version1/symbol7 original-ed6a0 override record and X64_REL32 relocation at f8011, including bounds, sizes and exact record bytes. Retpoline-present alone is insufficient. Do not apply arbitrary function-override or BDD records.

Decode the current signed E9 displacement, derive T=stub+5+disp32, and reject overflow. Authenticate RtlpScpCfgNtdllExports and its relocated source-begin/end qwords against file base relocations and the pinned SCPCFGNP section/span/hash. Read the exact six-DWORD header and require dispatch offset c0, not a guessed table type.

Derive cloneBase=T-c0. VirtualQuery must establish the complete bounded source-size range as committed read-execute non-writable MEM_IMAGE, allocation base equal to the authenticated ntdll base, region base equal to cloneBase and enough region size. Resolve its mapped backing file to that same authenticated ntdll file, including device-path/canonical-file identity handling. This is required even when T lies beyond ntdll SizeOfImage; never accept MEM_PRIVATE, arbitrary executable memory or mere near-ntdll addresses.

Compare all 688 cloned bytes with the exact pinned source template, not merely JMP RAX. Confirm the source span has no base relocations requiring different bytes. Require T=cloneBase+c0 and 48 ff e0 at T. Independently read the authenticated LdrSystemDllInitBlock size and pointer at raw offset108; require that pointer equals T. No search for a similar page or a convenient ntdll pointer is allowed.

For this narrow observed variant also require the current CRT load-config guard-dispatch slot to remain the relocated default ed6c0 and ed6a0/default-target code to match disk. A different CFG checking/retpoline variant is not qualified by this artifact.

Keep exactly the one authenticated _initterm callback frame at return707d6 followed by the exact EXE continuation. Retain all current cursor/end/first-Neutral00 callback target and FName/NamePool/guard-register witnesses. Do not skip a synthetic ntdll frame or accept a generic PC in _initterm.

Reread stub bytes, import/export/pointer witnesses, mapping identity/protection, source/clone bytes and existing cold-state/code facts before returning to the synchronous loader continuation. Any incomplete read, drift, unsupported mapping or metadata/code discrepancy rejects without calling game/CRT callbacks or starting later retry.
reject: A bare E9 into ntdll, or a target inside an authenticated ntdll image without the exact template/export/relocation relationships
Private executable clone, writable target, wrong allocation base/backing file, mismatching full template, wrong OS initialization-block pointer
Changed callback loop, opcode/padding or undeclared code bytes; altered guard slot, additional dispatch, call/push/stack-changing code or unqualified CFG/retpoline variant
Assuming IMAGE_GUARD_RETPOLINE_PRESENT or an arbitrary DVRT record authorizes all loader patches
Using this own-process sample to attribute the unrecorded game rejection, or accepting another OS build without review
Broadening the exact first-SRW source, its frame sequence or any later owner/subscription/registration/lifetime gate

validation.remaining_limit: No blanket authenticity proof against a hostile process rewriting every corroborating OS mapping/metadata. Exact pinned-image, mapped-file, declared-fixup, OS-export and code-shape checks reject nonstandard hooks within the selected normal-environment threat model.
